sn1.79:1.1: _Pātheyya_ is equivalent to the archaic Latinate _viatica_, “provisions for a journey”. Both this question and the next have the literal sense of safeguarding one’s possessions.
sn1.79:1.2: _Āsaya_ here has the sense of a place of safety, which for wealth is a “vault”.
sn1.79:2.1: The Buddha elevates the meaning, since faith holds all the factors of the path together.
